output.summary: Group ticket time rose about 4 minutes in every location in October 2024. That matches the board-approved Made Here redesign, whose minutes projected the rise, accepted it, and set a 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction, food quality, same-store sales and average check are all up. The 12-minute benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens. Riverside's rise began in August 2026, after the saute/pasta cook resigned. The vacancy is unfilled and transfer requests were deferred by group operations. The extra time sits on the saute/pasta station. The reason Delgado left is disputed and unresolved. The repeat-visit rise is confounded by a change in measurement method. Standardizing on frozen components, the 12-minute bonus target, or replacing the GM would all be harmful. Restoring Riverside's fourth line position is the priority.
